name: Wuxi Zhenhua Auto Parts Co.,Ltd.
summary: Wuxi Zhenhua Auto Parts Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells auto parts in China. The company provides assembly products, including roof edge beam reinforcement plate, roof cross beam, a- and b-pillar reinforcement plate assembly, front and rear wheel cover, front and rear longitudinal beam assemblies, as well as body hinge, rear part of the rear floor, fuel tank strap, and heat shield, reinforcement plate, oil pan, converter housing, battery tray, explosion shock sensor harness bracket, and electromagnetic shielding cover products.
